title: Italian Farro Salad with Cherry Tomatoes, Basil & Feta
description: Farro is an ancient wheat grain with an intact bran coat and low GI (~40). Its dense amylose starch matrix requires prolonged enzymatic breakdown, sustaining satiety without sharp glucose spikes.
diabeticNotes: Ancient grain whole farro retains its intact bran and germ layers, yielding a low-GI carbohydrate release. Genuine Greek sheep milk feta adds conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) and protein that blunts the glycemic response.

steps.title: Simmer Whole Farro
steps.description: Rinse whole farro. Simmer in salted boiling water for 25 minutes until al dente, drain, and cool.

steps.title: Chop Fresh Vegetables
steps.description: Halve cherry tomatoes and dice crisp English cucumber into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Combine Farro & Veggies
steps.description: In a large mixing bowl, combine cooled farro, halved cherry tomatoes, and diced cucumber.

steps.title: Dress with Olive Oil
steps.description: Drizzle extra virgin olive oil over the farro mixture and toss gently until evenly coated.

steps.title: Fold Feta & Serve
steps.description: Crumble Greek feta cheese over the salad and gently fold to combine without breaking up cheese.
